items.title: Former German spy chief arrested for espionage and treason
items.description: August Hanning is accused of obtaining classified information for a foreign power.

items.title: Ship sinks and crew missing after Black Sea drone attack
items.description: It is not clear who is behind the attacks which come as Russia intensifies strikes in the Black Sea as part of its war against Ukraine.

items.title: Defence lawyer in Cornell University case calls for special prosecutor to be removed
items.description: New York Attorney General Letitia James is investigating the rape allegations, but the lawyer says comments she made on the case should disqualify her.

items.title: Fort Hood shooter to be executed by firing squad - a first for US military since World War Two
items.description: Nidal Malik Hasan killed 13 unarmed soldiers and injured another 32 in the deadliest ever non-combat attack on an American military base.

items.title: 'Ghost particles' from space telescope wins physics Nobel
items.description: Belgian physicist Prof Francis Halzen has won for his pioneering work on an observatory that detects particles from space.

items.title: Saudi Arabia urged to spare man sentenced to death over Facebook post
items.description: Anojan Sivarasa faces execution after he was found guilty of blasphemy over a Facebook comment.

items.title: Indian opposition MPs detained in protest against election chief
items.description: Opposition leaders have alleged that CEC Gyanesh Kumar manipulated voter rolls to favour Prime Minister Narendra Modi's party during elections.

items.title: Seven arrested for using Ghanaian banknotes to make 'money bouquets'
items.description: The arrests are part of the country's efforts to curb the misuse and abuse of the national currency.

items.title: Yemeni military says it has 'secured' Red Sea waterway
items.description: Saudi-backed forces gave conflicting reports of whether they had also seized the port city of Mokha, near the Bab al-Mandab Strait.

items.title: Kenya confirms its first Ebola death as outbreak spreads
items.description: The patient had been living in DR Congo, where more than 4,000 people have died from the disease this year.

items.title: Nigeria mourns 25 killed as military plane crashes into swamp
items.description: President Bola Tinubu describes the crash as a "painful moment" for the military and the entire nation.

items.title: Separatist party projected to win Quebec election, adding new test to Canada's unity
items.description: The Parti Québécois, which secured a minority, has vowed to hold an independence referendum in the years to come.
